about_the_game:
Bring the amazing sounds of Ra Ra BOOM into your earholes with the Official Soundtrack. Featuring 23 songs, this non-stop score of heart-pounding, rock-tinged beats comes courtesy of DJ duo Toy District.

Get it separately or as part of the Ra Ra BOOM Deluxe Edition.
